identificationModule.briefTitle: Pharmacokinetic Study in Elderly Patients With Chronic Obstructive Bronchitis (COPD)
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Pharmacokinetics, Safety and Tolerability of Tiotropium in Elderly COPD Patients (Open Label, Monocenter Study).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Study to evaluate the pharmacokinetics of tiotropium following 14 days of administration (18µg once per day) in elderly COPD patients.

armGroups.label: Tiotropium inhalation capsules
interventionNames: Drug: Tiotropium inhalation capsules for oral inhalation

interventions.name: Tiotropium inhalation capsules for oral inhalation

primaryOutcomes.measure: Total area under the plasma drug concentration-time curve (AUC 0-4 h)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: pre-dose and 5, 20 min., 1, 2,and 4 hours after dosing on days 1, 7 and 14

primaryOutcomes.measure: Terminal elimination half-life after the last dose
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: pre dose and 5, 20 min., 1, 2,and 4 hours after dosing on days 1, 7 and 14

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Plasma concentration of drug 5 min after inhalation (C5min)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: pre dose and 5, 20 min., 1, 2,and 4 hours after dosing on days 1, 7 and 14

secondaryOutcomes.measure: tmax (time of occurrence for maximum drug concentration)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: pre dose and 5, 20 min., 1, 2,and 4 hours after dosing on days 1, 7 and 14

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in FEV1 (Forced expiratory volume in one second)
Change from baseline in FVC (Forced vital capacity)
